events.verdict: Doncic (DAL) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Irving (DAL) contests the layup attempt and any contact with Beal's (PHX) arm is marginal.
Durant (PHX) legally contests Irving's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Dinwiddie (DAL) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Beal (PHX) during the loose ball.
Gafford (DAL) briefly places an arm around Nurkic's (PHX) side and immediately slides it off without affecting his FOM.
Nurkic (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Irving's (DAL) possession.
Nurkic (PHX) firms up in a screening position and allows Thompson (DAL) to avoid the contact.
Thompson (DAL) reaches in and initiates contact to Booker's (PHX) arm, which affects his ability to pass.
Nurkic (PHX) and Marshall (DAL) engage as Marshall moves underneath the screen and the contact is marginal.
Beal (PHX) cleanly deflects the ball away from Gafford (DAL) during the rebound as Nurkic (PHX) brushes Gafford's arm.
Nurkic (PHX) jumps to contest the pass by Doncic (DAL) and as he returns to the floor, he inadvertently steps on Doncic's foot. There is no illegal contact between the two players.
O'Neale (PHX) places his hands on Gafford's (DAL) back as he is leaning forwards and the marginal contact does not dislodge him from his rebounding position.

Although Gafford (DAL) also makes contact with the ball, there is illegal contact during Nurkic's (PHX) shot attempt near the rim. The game clock continues to run to 00:00.0 and officials trigger a replay review to determine if the foul occurs before the expiration of the game clock. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the illegal contact during Nurkic's shot attempt occurs with 0.8 seconds remaining on the game clock.
